reason: I order from Talabat and Breadfast and I throw out vegetables every week, so the problem is real. But I earn little, I don't plan, and I don't believe an app will make me scan receipts when I'm already tired.
objection: Receipt scanning never reads Arabic receipts properly. If it gets my receipts wrong I will have to fix everything by hand, and then I stop using it after a week. Also most of my groceries come through delivery apps, not paper receipts.
would_change_my_mind: If it pulled my orders straight from Talabat or Noon without scanning anything, or I saw it read a real Arabic receipt correctly, I would try the free version.
